observations.behavior: Adds two bullets to the SKILL.md instructions for the PR description writing agent, specifying that each user-visible change bullet must describe the effect and a separate line must identify mechanical changes.
observations.code_quote: - Every Changes bullet a person can notice says what they now see or do differently, then the mechanism under it. One user-facing line in Problem does not discharge this.
observations.posthog_connection: These instructions guide an agent that generates PR descriptions. The change tightens the agent's behavior to distinguish user-visible effects from implementation details, potentially improving the quality and clarity of generated descriptions.

observations.behavior: Reorders and slightly edits the checklist for PR descriptions, moving the check for user-visible changes to the top and adding a check for the agent context section.
observations.code_quote: 5. Read Changes alone. Can you say what a person will now see or do differently, or that nothing user-visible changed? If neither, go back to pass 1.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the agent's checklist. The reordering and addition of checks could help the agent prioritize user-visible changes and complete the agent context section, potentially improving the reliability of the generated descriptions.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment to the PR template instructing contributors to describe user-visible effects rather than just the code path.
observations.code_quote: <!-- For each change a person can notice, say what they will now see or do differently, not only the code path that does it. Mark the rest as mechanical so a reviewer knows nothing user-visible is hiding in it. -->
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a reminder to human contributors. This could help humans write better PR descriptions, but the change is not implemented in the agent's instructions or the template itself, so the benefit is not demonstrated.
